seoTitle: How to Sync Asana Calendar With Outlook
metaDescription: Learn how to sync Asana deadlines with Microsoft Outlook in 2026 using a live iCal feed link so project milestones update automatically.
intro: Rather than re-entering deadlines by hand, Asana can generate a live calendar feed that Outlook subscribes to directly. This guide covers finding the iCal feed link inside Asana, subscribing to it from Outlook, and confirming due date changes carry through automatically.

steps.heading: Open the Calendar tab in Asana
steps.body: Go to a project or your personal My Tasks section and switch to the Calendar view tab.

steps.heading: Find the export and sync options
steps.body: Open the project dropdown menu to locate the export and sync settings for that project.

steps.heading: Generate and copy the iCal feed link
steps.body: Generate a secure, real-time iCal subscription link and copy the sync URL.

steps.heading: Subscribe in Outlook
steps.body: Open Microsoft Outlook's calendar addition panel and choose the From Internet subscription option, then paste in the Asana sync URL.

steps.heading: Name and verify the calendar
steps.body: Name your new integrated calendar, customize its overlay color, and confirm that due date updates in Asana reflect automatically in Outlook.

faq.question: Does Outlook update the calendar in real time?
faq.answer: Outlook periodically refreshes iCal subscriptions rather than instantly, so there can be a short delay before recent changes appear.

faq.question: Can I sync a personal My Tasks list into Outlook, not just a project?
faq.answer: Yes, you can generate the same type of feed link from your personal My Tasks calendar view.

faq.question: Is the sync two-way between Outlook and Asana?
faq.answer: No, this is a one-way feed from Asana into Outlook, so changes made in Outlook won't update the original Asana task.

faq.question: What happens if I lose or regenerate the feed URL?
faq.answer: If you regenerate the sync link in Asana, you'll need to re-subscribe in Outlook using the new URL for the calendar to keep updating.
